# What `pnpm verify` runs

> **In plain words.** One command checks everything before a push. It runs the gates below in order and prints one line per gate; the first gate that fails prints its whole output and stops the run. The quick gates come first (they need no dependencies and take a second); then the formatter, the linter, the type check, the build of the command-line tool, that tool's own manifest check on the client template and the kit's test Worker configurations, and the two test suites. The same command runs in GitHub Actions on every push to `main`, so a red run is visible on the repository page.

| Order | Gate | Command | What it refuses |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | agents | `node scripts/check-agents.mjs` | ai.md or rules.md over budget; a rule line in ai.md with no rule in rules.md, or the reverse; a pointer file that differs from its template; a copied fact (a count next to table, migration, route or binding, a UUID shape, a hostname) in an instruction file |
| 2 | tokens | `node scripts/check-tokens.mjs` | a secret name used in a workflow or a `wrangler secret put` command without a row in the token registry; a row with a missing field, an unknown status or a duplicate name |
| 3 | identifiers | `node scripts/check-identifiers.mjs` | a name of the first client's existing platform or repositories anywhere in the repository; a UUID shape, a long hex identifier or an email address |
| 4 | deps | `node scripts/check-deps.mjs` | a dependency without a row in the dependency registry, one not pinned once in the catalog, a package.json carrying its own version, a registered row nothing uses |
| 5 | docs | `node scripts/check-docs.mjs` | a generated document that differs from its source; a document under docs/ missing from the index or without front matter; a document over its size budget; a relative link that points nowhere |
| 6 | format | `pnpm exec prettier --check .` | a code file not formatted by Prettier (run pnpm format) |
| 7 | lint | `pnpm exec eslint .` | an ESLint finding, including a module-boundary violation |
| 8 | typecheck | `pnpm -r run typecheck` | a type error in any package or module; each one is checked against the runtime it is typed for (the Workers runtime, or Node for the command-line tool) |
| 9 | build | `pnpm --filter @oltrem/cli run build` | a command-line tool that does not build; the next two gates run the built tool |
| 10 | manifest | `node packages/cli/dist/bin.js manifest check packages/core-config packages/core-outbox packages/core-audit packages/core-jobs modules/iam modules/users templates/client` | a binding, queue, class, cron, var or secret in the client template or one of the kit's own test Worker configurations that its oltrem.manifest.json does not list, one over its cap, or an env.NAME use the manifest does not list (R-09) |
| 11 | tests | `node --test scripts/**/*.test.mjs` | a failing test of the verify chain itself (Node's built-in runner, every *.test.mjs file under scripts/) |
| 12 | packages | `pnpm exec vitest run` | a failing package or module test; Worker code is tested inside the Workers runtime with the bindings its wrangler configuration declares, the command-line tool on Node |

A gate is never skipped, weakened or bypassed to get green (R-02): the cause is fixed. A new gate is a new entry in `scripts/lib/gates.mjs`, a test, and this page regenerated with `pnpm docs:build`.
